Review of [Lulu and Georgia](https://www.trustpilot.com/review/www.luluandgeorgia.com)

* * *

## [I was so excited to design a room with…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/6a0f41713a51ac2f51bcc979)
I was so excited to design a room with this company. I even started the process and bought a few things. This company has zero follow through. They say "we are so excited to work on your project", then they don't respond to texts and never send the email they said they would send. I'm not chasing after people. I can take my business elsewhere.

May 8, 2026

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

May 21, 2026

Hi Anne,

Thank you for your feedback! We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience you've experienced with our Design Services. I understand how frustrating it can be when you’re excited to create your perfect room and communication falls short. Our Customer Support team is here to assist you throughout the ordering process via email, phone, and Live Chat during regular business hours. Please let us know how we can help with your order or any concerns you have, we are happy to help!

Lulu and Georgia
